title: MySQL connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One MySQL connector instance's settings: where the server is, what to read or write, and the chunk size for the key-range read. Covers the batch source and the upsert sink of the ★ MySQL connector (design §33 §8 row 3; CN1 plan Task 7). `password` and `tls.key_pem` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list. The sink's `key` is required by CN1 Task 1's rule that a sink declaring `upsert` declares a key.

dsn.description: A mysql_async URL, as an alternative to host/port/database/user.

user.description: The account the connector authenticates as.

password.description: The account's password, or an AWS RDS IAM token when iam is configured. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

table.description: The table this instance reads or writes; may be omitted when a route names the table.

partitions.description: Parallel workers the key range is split across (CN1 Task 7).

chunk_size.description: Rows per chunk of SELECT … WHERE pk > ? ORDER BY pk LIMIT n (CN1 Task 7).

cursor_column.description: Incremental mode's high-water column. Without it the source reads the full key range.

key_column.description: The primary key the chunked read walks in order.

key.description: The sink's upsert key: INSERT … ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE. Required because the manifest declares capabilities.sink.upsert: true (CN1 Task 1's semantic rule).

batch_rows.description: Rows per upsert batch; CN1 Ruling 3 defaults the Arrow batch to 65536.

append.description: Sink mode: plain INSERT instead of ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE.

apply_deletes.description: Apply deletes for events carrying loamsop = d (§33 §6).

tls.description: TLS material. CN1 Task 7 verifies the server with verify-full.

enabled.description: Whether TLS is on at all.

key_pem.description: The client certificate's private key. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

verify_full.description: Whether the server certificate's hostname is verified.

iam.description: AWS RDS IAM token auth (CN1 Task 7), which replaces the password.

region.description: The AWS region of the instance.

role_arn.description: The role Loams assumes; the default chain is used when absent.
